verdicts.quote: The default schedule has exactly five steps at offsets -3, 0, +3, +7 and +14 calendar days from the due date

No automatic reminder is sent for an invoice in any of these states: Draft (never issued), Paid, Void (cancelled) or Deleted; together with Uncollectible (C-88) these are all the invoice states that stop reminders
verdicts.missing: Credited invoices (credit notes) and invoices on a payment plan are not addressed; disputes only appear as an example of a manual pause (U-7), not as a stopping condition.

verdicts.quote: A partial payment does not stop reminders; the next reminder shows the balance still outstanding

reminders for an invoice are held back by exactly these conditions: reminders switched Off, the invoice paused, the customer paused, the customer opted out, the customer archived, and no deliverable recipient
verdicts.missing: Whether a pre-existing do-not-contact or marketing unsubscribe state on the customer is honoured, and whether billing reminders are exempt from a marketing opt-out, is not stated; only the feature's own opt-out is defined.

verdicts.quote: once it has a final outcome it is never attempted again ... no later run, restart, retry or schedule edit produces a second message for that invoice, offset and recipient
Immediately before a reminder is handed to the email provider, the system re-reads the invoice and its customer, and sends only if the invoice is still a candidate
the system retries up to 3 times, at 15 minutes, 1 hour and 4 hours after the previous attempt ... If the 14:15 attempt also fails the row shows Failed
The system hands messages to the provider no faster than 10 per second, and when the provider limits it by rate or by a daily quota, the remaining steps are deferred to the next run
when reminders are switched On at 2026-06-20 10:00, has its first four steps shown as Skipped "before eligibility" and receives the 06-24 step
The send time is a time of day from 00:00 to 23:59 in the business time zone, default 09:00 (C-22: Reminders are sent on any day of the week, including Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays)
Amounts are shown in the invoice's own currency using that currency's standard number of decimal places
When an invoice has no deliverable recipient address at its step's moment, the step is Skipped with reason "no recipient" and appears in the attention list

The recipients of a reminder are the billing email addresses currently recorded for the invoice (the invoice's own list where it has one, otherwise its customer's billing addresses), read at send time, up to 5 addresses
Each invoice shows, for every reminder attempt, these fields: time, step offset (or Manual), recipient address, outcome, and reason
the invoice number, the outstanding balance with its currency, the due date, a timing statement, a way to pay, a link to the invoice (C-51: stays valid for at least 90 days)
Only users with permission to manage billing can change reminder settings, pause, resume, send now, send a test, clear an opt-out or clear a suppression
reminders On/Off ... pause and resume per customer, send reminder now per invoice, send test reminder
Each invoice shows its next reminder (date and time and offset) or, where there is none, exactly one reason (C-77: list of reminders needing attention ... Failed or Bounced)
Under normal operation a step's reminder is handed to the email provider within 60 minutes after its scheduled moment, never before it
Sending a reminder does not change any invoice's status, amount, due date or recipients
